req.title: Login form GET
req.statement: The system shall serve a login form at GET /auth/login.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the login form should be served at GET /auth/login with an HTTP 2xx response. We need to test this functionality with positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness. The positive case will verify the correct serving of the login form, the negative case will simulate a client error, and the boundary case will test the response when the endpoint is accessed with minimal valid input.

tests.name: test_login_form_get_positive
preconditions: The application is running with the test configuration.
expected: The response contains the login form HTML.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/auth/login')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'<form' in r.data and b'name="username"' in r.data and b'name="password"' in r.data

tests.name: test_login_form_get_negative
preconditions: The application is running with the test configuration.
actions: Send a GET request to an invalid endpoint /auth/loginn.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
try:
    r = client.get('/auth/loginn')
    assert r.status_code == 404
except AssertionError:
    print('Expected 404 Not Found for invalid endpoint')

tests.name: test_login_form_get_boundary
preconditions: The application is running with the test configuration.
actions: Send a GET request to /auth/login with minimal headers.
expected: The response contains the login form HTML.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/auth/login', headers={'User-Agent': ''})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'<form' in r.data and b'name="username"' in r.data and b'name="password"' in r.data
